rows.claim: Exact OpenMW source pin and Lua API revision are machine-readable and have a repeatable validation command
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records a successful evidence-validation execution against a clean commit

rows.claim: Content-addressed source cache validation has repeatable absence, tamper, and wrong-commit tests
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records a successful Python test execution against a clean commit

rows.claim: Strict offline reconstruction is implemented for the pinned OpenMW source cache
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records successful offline reconstruction from a verified cache against a clean commit

rows.claim: Ordered exact-pin OpenMW patch and overlay validation has a repeatable test and audit command
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records successful patch validation and tests against a clean commit

rows.claim: Strict local v1 schemas, classified fixtures, deterministic manifests, and a loopback fake-server harness are implemented
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records successful protocol and loopback test executions against a clean commit

rows.claim: The pure native bridge has a warning-clean direct compiler test entry point
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records successful native compilation and execution against a clean commit

rows.claim: The native sanitizer runtime suite completes successfully on a supported host
rows.resume_when: Run the sanitizer suite to completion on a compatible host and record its durable result

rows.claim: The Lua architecture and pinned-source manifest declarations have a dedicated structural checker
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records a successful Lua structural-check execution against a clean commit

rows.claim: The Lua suite passes under an available Lua interpreter against the fake OpenMW harness
rows.resume_when: A supported Lua runtime is available and a durable runtime result is recorded

rows.claim: The no-game Python test suite is implemented
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records a successful full Python test execution against a clean commit

rows.claim: Deterministic fixture ZIP/TAR, manifest, checksum, SPDX, linkage, and ownership tests are implemented
rows.resume_when: A durable run manifest records a successful packaging test execution against a clean commit

rows.claim: Fail-closed source, package, provenance, secret, proprietary-data, privacy, and reproducibility audits are implemented
rows.resume_when: Durable run manifests record successful audit and provenance executions against a clean commit

rows.claim: Immutable-action CI definitions describe foundation and standalone-native platform commands and record hosted tool identities
rows.resume_when: Qualifying CI executions are recorded; hosted toolchains remain non-immutable release inputs

rows.claim: Exact-pin OpenMW package registration and media VFS-versus-decoder patches plus patched-engine and unmodified control builds pass
rows.resume_when: Implement the exact pinned patches and record integrated plus control build evidence

rows.claim: The Beast serializer and authenticated loopback transport pass on the live wire
rows.resume_when: Implement the Beast serializer/transport and record live-wire tests

rows.claim: Final SYNTH and Synthserver SHAs are imported and migrated and cross-repository protocol/parity checks pass
rows.resume_when: Final tested SYNTH and Synthserver SHAs are supplied and cross-repository work is authorized

rows.claim: Windows x64 exact-pin control/product builds and legal-game/mod acceptance profiles pass
rows.resume_when: Run and durably record qualifying Windows builds and legal-data acceptance evidence

rows.claim: The release-named runtime/Lua/source set passes exact-source audits and is signed and published
rows.resume_when: Built product, exact corresponding source, signing authority, and publication authorization are available
